```{r data}
df_time <- read_csv("bike+sharing+dataset/hour.csv")[, -1]  %>%
  mutate(
    datetime = ymd_h(paste(dteday, hr))
  )


Training_time <- df_time %>%
  filter(
    datetime >= ymd_h("2011-01-01 00"),
    datetime <= ymd_h("2012-6-30 23")
  )
Testing_time <- df_time %>% 
    filter(
    datetime >= ymd_h("2012-7-01 00")
  )


train_ts <- Training_time %>%
  as_tsibble(index = datetime)%>%
  fill_gaps(cnt = 0)
```

```{r}
time_slot <- c("season", "yr", "mnth", "hr")


time_slot %>%
  map(~
    ggplot(Training_time, aes(x = factor(.data[[.x]]), y = cnt)) +
      geom_boxplot(fill = "lightblue", outlier.alpha = 0.3) +
      labs(
        title = paste0("一天中按 ", .x, " 的租借量分布"),
        x = .x,
        y = "租借量 (cnt)"
      ) +
      theme_minimal()) %>%
  wrap_plots()


Training_time %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = hr, y = cnt, color = factor(workingday))) +
  # 用 stat_summary 自动计算每个小时的平均值画折线
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", size = 1.2) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("0" = "coral", "1" = "steelblue"),
    labels = c("非工作日", "工作日"),
    name = "类型"
  ) +
  labs(title = "workingday vs not workingday 的每小时平均租借量", x = "小时", y = "平均租借量") +
  theme_minimal()



```


```{r}
# 预定义顺序
mnth_order <- c("January","February","March","April","May","June","July","August","September","October","November","December")
weekday_order <- c("Sunday","Monday","Tuesday","Wednesday","Thursday","Friday","Saturday")

# 图1：月份 (柱状图)
plot1 <- Training_time %>% 
  group_by(mnth) %>% 
  summarise(avg = mean(count, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(mnth = factor(mnth, levels = mnth_order)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = mnth, y = avg)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(title = "Average Count By mnth", x = "mnth", y = "Average Count") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# 图2：季节 x 小时 (点线图)
plot2 <- Training_time %>% 
  group_by(hr, season) %>% 
  summarise(avg = mean(count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = hr, y = avg, color = season)) +
  geom_point() + geom_line() +
  labs(title = "Average Users Count By hr Of The Day Across Season", 
       x = "hr Of The Day", y = "Users Count") +
  theme_minimal()

# 图3：星期 x 小时 (点线图)
plot3 <- Training_time %>% 
  group_by(hr, weekday) %>% 
  summarise(avg = mean(count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(weekday = factor(weekday, levels = weekday_order)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = hr, y = avg, color = weekday)) +
  geom_point() + geom_line() +
  labs(title = "Average Users Count By hr Of The Day Across Weekdays", 
       x = "hr Of The Day", y = "Users Count") +
  theme_minimal()

# 图4：用户类型 x 小时 (点线图)
plot4 <- Training_time %>% 
  select(hr, casual, registered) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(casual, registered), names_to = "type", values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(hr, type) %>% 
  summarise(avg = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = hr, y = avg, color = type)) +
  geom_point() + geom_line() +
  labs(title = "Average Users Count By hr Of The Day Across User Type", 
       x = "hr Of The Day", y = "Users Count") +
  theme_minimal()

plot1 
plot2 
plot3 
plot4
# 拼图

```


```{r}
# 1. 查看自相关性 (ACF) - 检查日周期和周周期
train_ts %>%
  ACF(cnt, lag_max = 168) %>% # 看过去一周 (24*7)
  autoplot() +
  labs(title = "Autocorrelation of Hourly Bike Rentals")

# 2. STL 分解 (趋势 + 季节性 + 残差)
train_ts %>%
  model(STL(cnt ~ season(window = "periodic") + trend(window = 24*7))) %>%
  components() %>%
  autoplot() +
  labs(title = "STL Decomposition")
```


```{r}
# 拟合模型
fit <- train_ts %>%
  model(
    # 1. 自动 ARIMA（等价于 auto.arima）
    ARIMA = ARIMA(cnt),
    
    # 2. 指数平滑 (ETS)
    ETS = ETS(cnt)
  )

# 查看模型结果报告
report(fit)
```
